moments.title: August Bank Holiday approaches
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, offering a final long weekend of summer for many.

angles.name: Travel Alert
angles.copy: Planning a last-minute getaway for the August Bank Holiday? Expect busy roads and potential train disruptions across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland. Travel smart!

angles.name: Relaxation Reminder
angles.copy: One more long weekend before autumn truly kicks in! How are you making the most of the August Bank Holiday, August 31st? Lie-in, BBQ, or a bit of both?

moments.title: US Open Tennis kicks off
moments.blurb: The final Grand Slam of the tennis season, the US Open, officially begins today with qualifying rounds and mixed doubles, leading into the main draw on August 30th.

angles.name: Tournament Start
angles.copy: Game, Set, Match! The US Open 2026 is officially underway in New York today with qualifying action. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Main Draw Anticipation
angles.copy: While qualifying heats up, the main draw for the US Open 2026 starts this Sunday, August 30th. Get ready for two weeks of epic tennis!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival returns
moments.blurb: Reading and Leeds Festival, one of the UK's biggest music events, is set to electrify audiences from Friday, August 28th to Sunday, August 30th, over the Bank Holiday weekend.

angles.name: Festival Excitement
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festival is just days away! Who's packing their wellies and heading for a weekend of live music, August 28-30? Drop your must-see acts!

angles.name: Local Buzz
angles.copy: Leeds Festival fans, the countdown is ON! Get ready for a huge weekend of music starting this Friday. Who are you buzzing to see on stage?

moments.title: Happy 78th to Jean-Michel Jarre
moments.blurb: French electronic music pioneer Jean-Michel Jarre celebrates his 78th birthday today, August 24th.

angles.name: Electronic Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 78th birthday to the maestro of electronic music, Jean-Michel Jarre! Still pioneering after all these years.

angles.name: Oxygène Legend
angles.copy: Today we're celebrating the birthday of Jean-Michel Jarre, the visionary behind 'Oxygène'. His soundscapes defined a generation!

moments.title: Gene Simmons turns 77
moments.blurb: KISS bassist and co-founder Gene Simmons celebrates his 77th birthday tomorrow, August 25th.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the 'Demon' himself, Gene Simmons of KISS, turns 77! What's your favourite KISS track to crank up?

angles.name: KISS Icon
angles.copy: Happy almost birthday to Gene Simmons! The KISS legend celebrates turning 77 tomorrow. Still rock and roll all nite!

moments.title: Billy Ray Cyrus is 65
moments.blurb: Country music star Billy Ray Cyrus, known for 'Achy Breaky Heart', celebrates his 65th birthday tomorrow, August 25th.

angles.name: Country Star
angles.copy: Get ready to wish Billy Ray Cyrus a very happy 65th birthday tomorrow! Still can't get 'Achy Breaky Heart' out of our heads.

angles.name: Achy Breaky Birthday
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the man behind the iconic 'Achy Breaky Heart' turns 65! Happy birthday to Billy Ray Cyrus!

moments.title: Shirley Manson turns 60
moments.blurb: Garbage frontwoman and Scottish rock icon Shirley Manson celebrates her 60th birthday on Wednesday, August 26th.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a fierce 60th birthday to the incredible Shirley Manson of Garbage this Wednesday! What's your favourite Garbage anthem?

angles.name: Garbage Queen
angles.copy: She's 'Only Happy When It Rains' but we're happy to celebrate Shirley Manson's 60th birthday this Wednesday! A true 90s legend.

moments.title: Tony Kanal turns 56
moments.blurb: No Doubt bassist and songwriter Tony Kanal celebrates his 56th birthday on Thursday, August 27th.

angles.name: No Doubt Bassist
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to No Doubt's rhythmic backbone, Tony Kanal, this Thursday! What's your favourite No Doubt banger?

angles.name: Ska-Punk Legend
angles.copy: From 'Just a Girl' to 'Hella Good', Tony Kanal shaped the sound of No Doubt. Wishing him a very happy 56th birthday on Thursday!

moments.title: Liam Payne is 33
moments.blurb: Former One Direction member Liam Payne celebrates his 33rd birthday on Saturday, August 29th.

angles.name: 1D Star
angles.copy: Get ready to wish Liam Payne a very happy 33rd birthday this Saturday! What's your favourite track from his One Direction days or solo career?

angles.name: Pop Birthday
angles.copy: The One Direction star, Liam Payne, celebrates his 33rd birthday on Saturday! Still remember those early X Factor days?

moments.title: Van Morrison turns 81
moments.blurb: Legendary Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison celebrates his 81st birthday on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Music Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 81st birthday to the iconic Van Morrison this Monday! What's your all-time favourite 'Van the Man' track?

angles.name: Brown Eyed Birthday
angles.copy: The voice behind 'Brown Eyed Girl' and 'Moondance', Van Morrison, turns 81 on Monday! Celebrate the legend!

moments.title: Debbie Gibson is 56
moments.blurb: 80s pop sensation Debbie Gibson, known for hits like 'Foolish Beat', celebrates her 56th birthday on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: 80s Pop Princess
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the original pop princess, Debbie Gibson, this Monday! What was your favourite 'Out of the Blue' track?

angles.name: Foolish Beat
angles.copy: She was the youngest female to write, produce, and perform a Billboard Hot 100 #1! Wishing Debbie Gibson a fabulous 56th birthday on Monday!

moments.title: Gloria Estefan turns 69
moments.blurb: Cuban-American pop icon and 'Queen of Latin Pop' Gloria Estefan celebrates her 69th birthday on Tuesday, September 1st.

angles.name: Latin Pop Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 69th birthday to the incredible Gloria Estefan this Tuesday! Her hits still make us 'Conga'!

angles.name: Miami Sound Machine
angles.copy: The 'Queen of Latin Pop', Gloria Estefan, turns 69 on Tuesday! Celebrate with some Miami Sound Machine classics.

moments.title: Barry Gibb is 80
moments.blurb: Bee Gees legend Sir Barry Gibb, known for his iconic falsetto and songwriting, celebrates his 80th birthday on Tuesday, September 1st.

angles.name: Bee Gees Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 80th birthday to the one and only Sir Barry Gibb this Tuesday! His music is truly 'Stayin' Alive'.

angles.name: Disco King
angles.copy: The legendary falsetto of Barry Gibb turns 80 on Tuesday! Celebrate the Bee Gees icon and disco king!

moments.title: Al Jardine turns 84
moments.blurb: Founding member of The Beach Boys, Al Jardine, known for his rhythm guitar and vocals, celebrates his 84th birthday on Thursday, September 3rd.

angles.name: Beach Boys Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 84th birthday to The Beach Boys' Al Jardine this Thursday! Thank you for the timeless tunes.

angles.name: Surf Rock Icon
angles.copy: From 'Help Me, Rhonda' to 'Sloop John B', Al Jardine helped define the sound of The Beach Boys. Happy 84th on Thursday!

moments.title: Jennifer Paige is 53
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Jennifer Paige, best known for her 1998 hit 'Crush', celebrates her 53rd birthday on Thursday, September 3rd.

angles.name: 90s Pop Hit
angles.copy: You can't deny that 'Crush' was a massive 90s banger! Happy 53rd birthday to Jennifer Paige this Thursday!

angles.name: One-Hit Wonder Love
angles.copy: That song still gives us all the feels! Wishing Jennifer Paige a fantastic 53rd birthday on Thursday!

moments.title: UK Singles Chart latest
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending August 29th (published this week) features new entries and movers, including KATSEYE's 'Hootie Frutti'.

angles.name: Chart New Entry
angles.copy: New music alert! KATSEYE's 'Hootie Frutti' is a fresh entry on the Official UK Singles Chart this week. What do you think of it?

angles.name: Top Hits Buzz
angles.copy: What's topping your playlist from this week's Official UK Singles Chart? Any surprises or familiar favourites holding strong?

moments.title: Strictly launch date confirmed
moments.blurb: The pre-recorded launch episode of Strictly Come Dancing 2026 is set to air on Saturday, September 19th, with the first live show following on September 26th.

angles.name: Strictly Countdown
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! The Strictly Come Dancing 2026 launch show is officially set for September 19th. Who are you excited to see on the dancefloor?

angles.name: New Hosts Anticipation
angles.copy: With new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe, Strictly 2026 promises a fresh feel! The launch is September 19th.

moments.title: Bake Off set to return
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is expected to return for its new series on Channel 4 on Tuesday, September 29th, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off Buzz
angles.copy: On your marks, get set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off is reportedly back on September 29th. Who's ready for some showstoppers?

angles.name: New Judge Excitement
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent as a new judge! The new series is expected to start September 29th. We can't wait!
